environment_design.derived_design_rule: drop latitude, longitude and original obs_id; retain taxon_name and nine environmental predictors in source row order; add AZ72_0000... stable design_row_id
environment_design.role: fixed exogenous design only; observed 18D response phenotypes are not generator inputs

environment_mode.PROCESS_BOTH: core4 plus all five process predictors can affect both within- and among-taxon phenotype components
environment_mode.PROCESS_AMONG_ONLY: core4 can affect both scales; all five process predictors can affect taxon means only

scale_coefficient_architecture.SHARED: the same module-by-predictor coefficient draw is used at within- and among-taxon scales wherever that predictor is permitted
scale_coefficient_architecture.INDEPENDENT: within- and among-taxon module-by-predictor coefficients are independent prior draws

residual_architecture.COUPLED: 75 percent of module-level residual variance is carried by a shared latent at each biological scale and 25 percent by module-specific latents
residual_architecture.MODULAR: module-level residuals are independent across registered measurement modules

priors.endpoint_loading_rule: deterministic SHA256(endpoint_id) mapped to [0.80,1.20]; positive loading; not fit to observed targets
priors.hue_rule: theta = 0.60 * colour_module_latent + Normal(0,0.35); emit sin(theta), cos(theta)
priors.coefficient_rule: module-by-predictor coefficients are zero-mean Normal prior draws using the fixed SD above; no coefficient is initialized from observed Azami R2, cosine, module contrast or partial-R2 targets

environment_component_rule.among: taxon medians of each design predictor, standardized across all taxa
environment_component_rule.within: observation predictor minus within-taxon mean, then weighted-standardized with inverse taxon sample-size weights
environment_component_rule.note: Using the frozen environmental design conditions the model on sampled ecological opportunity; it does not provide observed response phenotypes.

output_rule.columns: design row identity renamed obs_id, taxon_name, nine frozen environmental predictors, eighteen frozen response endpoints
output_rule.downstream: analysis/compute_azami_capitulum_v3_estimands.py must emit exactly 62 unique target keys

one_shot_rule: Do not remove model families, change coefficient/residual priors, modify endpoint loadings, or add target-specific effects after any 62-target model-family distances are inspected. Changes require v2 generator contract and a fresh one-shot run.
claim_boundary: These are deliberately minimal structural sufficiency models. Family ranking can show which architectural ingredients are needed to reproduce selected observational structure; it does not identify true causal environmental mechanisms, adaptation, selection, plasticity, defence or genetic/developmental modularity.
